description:
This process begins with monitoring inventory levels in a warehouse or store.
When stock reaches a predefined threshold, an automated alert or manual check signals the need to reorder.
The procurement team then places an order with suppliers, considering factors like cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability.
Once the order is placed, the inventory system updates with expected delivery dates.
Upon receiving the stock, it is inspected for quality, recorded in the system, and placed on shelves or in storage.
The process ends when the inventory levels are updated after the restock is complete.

  <bpmn:message id="Message_SupplierOrder" name="Supplier order"/>

    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place supplier order considering cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability" messageRef="Message_SupplierOrder">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Order_UpdateExpectedDate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateExpectedDate" name="Update expected delivery dates in inventory system">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Inspect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Record</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Destination</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock for quality">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Inspect_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in inventory system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Record</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Record_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StorageChoice" name="Choose stock destination">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Destination</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlaceOnShelves</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlaceInStorage</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOnShelves" name="Place stock on shelves">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlaceOnShelves</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Shelves_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceInStorage" name="Place stock in storage">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlaceInStorage</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Storage_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DestinationMerge" name="Merge destination paths">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Shelves_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Storage_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Destination_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RestockJoin" name="Restocking activities complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Inspect_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Record_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Destination_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_UpdateLevels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels after restock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_UpdateLevels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateLevels_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Monitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_Monitoring" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AutomatedAlert" name="Automated alert" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalChoice" targetRef="Task_SendAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ManualCheck" name="Manual check" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalChoice" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manual_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_SignalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_SignalMerge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_UpdateExpectedDate" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDate_ReceiveStock" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDate" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStock" targetRef="Gateway_RestockSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Inspect" sourceRef="Gateway_RestockSplit" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Record" sourceRef="Gateway_RestockSplit" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Destination" sourceRef="Gateway_RestockSplit" targetRef="Gateway_StorageChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Join" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Gateway_RestockJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Join" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Gateway_RestockJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceOnShelves" name="Shelves" sourceRef="Gateway_StorageChoice" targetRef="Task_PlaceOnShelves"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceInStorage" name="Storage" sourceRef="Gateway_StorageChoice" targetRef="Task_PlaceInStorage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shelves_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnShelves" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Storage_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInStorage" targetRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Destination_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_DestinationMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RestockJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_UpdateLevels" sourceRef="Gateway_RestockJoin" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateLevels_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_InventoryUpdated"/>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_InventoryRestocking">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SignalChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAlert</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManualCheck</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InspectQuality</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordStock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RestockJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ProcurementTeam" name="Procurement team">
